$comment: Advisories bun audit may report without failing CI, each until its expiry (tooling/supply-chain/bun-audit.mjs, docs/migration/renovate.md). An entry past `expires` fails; an entry bun no longer reports fails too, so delete it in the change that clears it.

advisories.reason: Build-time only: tailwindcss 3 > postcss-nested > postcss-selector-parser 6 in the editor's CSS build. The fix is in 7.1.6, which postcss-nested under Tailwind 3 does not accept; Tailwind 4 clears it (held, docs/migration/npm-latest.md).
